libretto.text: der Reinste war er, der mich verriet!
libretto.translation: he was the purest, who betrayed me!

libretto.text: Die Gattin trügend – treu dem Freunde, –
libretto.translation: Deceiving the wife – true to the friend, –

libretto.text: von der eig’nen Trauten – einzig ihm teuer, –
libretto.translation: from his own beloved – dear to him alone, –
